clinician.trajectory_summary: A 6-year-old girl with a history of relapsed neuroblastoma presented with persistent fever, abdominal pain, and hepatosplenomegaly after chemotherapy. Candida sp. was identified in blood culture. Abdominal ultrasound revealed focal hypoechoic nodular splenic lesions, raising suspicion for either tumor or Candida abscesses. A splenectomy was performed, and histological analysis of the spleen showed only chronic inflammatory process without tumor cells, confirming the diagnosis of candidiasis.
